name: ERP RevoGrid Gate 5B-5 — Insert/Delete Rows
base: Latest accepted Gate 5B-4 state supplied by the user
business_behavior: Insert Above/Below is allowed while Filter/Sort is active.
The inserted row stays visibly above/below the chosen row in the current working snapshot.
Edit/Paste/Insert do not auto-reapply Filter or Sort underneath the employee.
Opening the Excel-like Filter picker reads current row values.
Delete removes only selected visible row identities.
ClientKey remains row identity; DisplayOrder remains persistent ordering.
Normal DisplayOrder insertion uses a midpoint; exhausted gaps rebalance only a bounded neighborhood first.
Insert and multi-row Delete each record one Sheet History action.
Structural Insert/Delete/DisplayOrder changes participate in Change Engine Dirty state.
No database Save is added in this gate.

verification.dotnet_build: Not available in the assistant runtime; must be run on the user's machine.
